title: Safe Water for Kitui — program catchment v1
description: Canonical geo boundary for the clean-water program: one concave catchment polygon around Kitui town with one exclusion hole (gazetted quarry site), plus the registered rehabilitated water points used as withinRadius centers. The boundary_id is the CIDv1(raw, sha256) of the canonical-JSON bytes (sorted keys, no whitespace) of the `boundary` member — the oracle re-derives and verifies it before every geo answer, and the same bytes anchor on-chain as a collection LinkedResource when the engine's geo v2 surface activates (rfc-005 §3.2: re-drawing a boundary is a new anchored resource). Coordinates are integer micro-degrees ([lonMicro, latMicro]); rings are closed, exterior counterclockwise, holes clockwise, antimeridian pre-split per RFC 7946 §3.1.9.
source: Digitized from the Kitui Water Partnership program map (2026-07); quarry exclusion per county gazette notice. Canonical form per docs/rfcs/rfc-005-geo-v2-activation.md §3.
